texte.C'est le seul écran de cette section qui: This is the only screen in this section that judges the ORGANISATION and not the systems.
texte.C'est le socle que l'autorité contrôle,: This is the baseline the authority inspects, whatever the status.
texte.C'est le véhicule de la responsabilité :: This is the vehicle of responsibility: what the instructions do not say, the deployer will not implement, and the risk will be left with nobody carrying it.
texte.C'est là que vivent les preuves : critèr: This is where the evidence lives: acceptance criteria, verification results, the demonstration of non-overload, justifications.
texte.C'est un PLANCHER du plafond que la loi: This is a FLOOR on the ceiling that national law must provide for, not a European ceiling.
texte.C'est une CONDITION, pas un seuil. Sans: This is a CONDITION, not a threshold. Without it, article #(#) cannot be satisfied, however many thresholds are crossed elsewhere.
texte.C'est une incitation, pas une obligation: This is an encouragement, not an obligation of result — the text says « consider ».
texte.C'est une recommandation dans la norme,: This is a recommendation in the standard, not a requirement: it therefore weighs less, but its absence shows in an audit of actual use.
texte.C'est une voie de preuve directe pour l': This is a direct line of evidence for objective #: the qualification of the person doing the work is part of the value delivered to the client.
texte.C'est votre levier. Une notice muette su: This is your leverage. Instructions that are silent on human oversight are a provider's breach of article #, and you are the only party able to notice it before the authority does.
texte.C'est votre part du dispositif. La conce: This is your share of the arrangement. The provider's design oversees nothing until you have assigned someone and wired the measure into your operations.
texte.Cadre de gestion du risque lié aux TIC s: A sound and documented ICT risk management framework, including the protection of physical components and infrastructure
texte.Ce bloc NE S'AJOUTE PAS au profil : il l: This block DOES NOT ADD to the profile: it CAPS it. A category « proven » on the framework is no longer proven for a generative system if the profile's actions are not met there.
texte.Ce bloc ne s'ouvre pas pour vous, et le: This block does not open for you, and the reason is stated.
texte.Ce bloc ne vous concerne pas, et il ne s: This block does not concern you, and it will never open. The reason is named: this is not an oversight.
texte.Ce calcul porte sur les seuls éléments d: This calculation covers only the items declared. It prepares a reporting decision; it does not replace it, and it is not legal advice. In case of doubt, over-reporting can be discussed with the competent authority — a failure to report, far less so.
texte.Ce module décrit une procédure ; il ne p: This module describes a procedure; it pronounces no designation. The European Supervisory Authorities designate, and they alone. The list of designated providers is published and updated each year by the Joint Committee (article #(#)); it is not reproduced here, because a copied list ages without warning.
texte.Ce module mesure une déclaration, pas un: This module measures a declaration, not compliance. The article headings are those of the text published in the Official Journal of the Union; what each one requires is summarised by the firm and does not replace reading the article. No certification can be obtained against this text: DORA is an obligation, not a certifiable framework.
texte.Ce module prépare une qualification ; il: This module prepares a qualification; it does not pronounce it. The actual qualification is for the competent authority — the ACPR or the AMF in France, the European Supervisory Authorities at Union level.
texte.Ce module rapproche deux textes ; il ne: This module brings two texts together; it does not pronounce how they interlock. The exact scope of the carve-out is set by the national transposing provisions and by the guidelines the Commission publishes under article #(#) of Directive (EU) #/#. Only the published texts are authoritative.
texte.Ce module vise la révision # du catalogu: This module targets revision # of the catalogue, because that is the one the industrial overlay SP #-# Rev. # adapts. Revision # is the current version: it adds the PT and SR families, and renames CA. A system already aligned on revision # needs to know this before reading this rate.
This module targets revision # of the catalogue, because that is the one the industrial overlay SP #-# Rev. # adapts. Revision # is the current version.
texte.Ce n'est ni une mesure de gestion du ris: This is neither a risk-management measure nor an incident notification: article #(#) does not reach it.
texte.Ce n'est pas une dispense : le risque re: This is not an exemption: the risk remains, and other measures have to carry it. The record says only that human oversight will not.
texte.Ce n'est pas une note sur dix : c'est un: This is not a mark out of ten: it is a profile and its blind spots.
texte.Ce n'est pas vous qui désignez. Les auto: It is not you who designates. The European Supervisory Authorities do, and clearing step # does not amount to a designation.
texte.Ce ne sont PAS les risques du système d': These are NOT the risks of the AI system — those come under article # and §#.
texte.Ce ne sont pas des classifications exclu: These are not exclusive classifications to which the whole system would be assigned: one and the same system carries different configurations depending on the scenario, and a scenario may combine several of them.
texte.Ce qu'il en coûte, dans cette maison, de: What it costs, in this firm, to say no.
texte.Ce qu'il fait, et ce qu'il ne sait pas f: What it does, and what it cannot do.
texte.Ce qu'il faut surveiller et mesurer est-: Has what needs to be monitored and measured been determined, and is it measured?
texte.Ce qu'on fait des jeux de données, de le: What is done with the data sets, from their governance to their retention.
texte.Ce qu'on mesure, comment, et ce qu'on a: What is measured, how, and what has been given up on measuring.
texte.Ce qu'on surveille une fois le système e: What is monitored once the system is in service, and how.
texte.Ce qu'on traite, et ce qu'on accepte par: What is treated, and what is accepted in writing.
texte.Ce qu'un certificat ISO # ou ISO/IEC # a: What an ISO # or ISO/IEC # certificate already brings, what it does NOT bring, and the other harmonised standards of the family.
texte.Ce qu'une certification ISO/IEC # docume: What an ISO/IEC # certification already documents among the articles of the delegated regulation — and what it does not.
texte.Ce qu'une entité doit déterminer et éval: What an entity must determine and assess when it subcontracts ICT services supporting critical or important functions.
texte.Ce que ce bloc attend est renseigné. Cel: What this block expects has been filled in. That does not amount to compliance.
texte.Ce que chaque catégorie demande, sous-ca: What each category asks for, sub-category by sub-category.
texte.Ce que coûte le parc déclaré : couvertur: What the declared estate costs: how much of it can be quantified, amounts by risk level, allocation, levers.
texte.Ce que le prestataire désigné doit fourn: What the designated provider must supply, in what form, and what the competent authority then assesses at the client financial entity.
texte.Ce que le système fait à ceux qui ne l'o: What the system does to those who did not choose it.
texte.Ce que pèse le parc déclaré : électricit: What the declared estate weighs: electricity, CO₂e, water, and the trajectory to the horizon chosen.
texte.Ce que vous faites du produit : concevoi: What you do with the product: design it, import it, distribute it, sell it under your own brand, modify it.
texte.Ce que vous mettez en œuvre reste sous v: What you implement stays your responsibility: assigning competent designated persons, meeting the conditions of use, and checking that the measure works on your side.
texte.Ce questionnaire porte sur ISO/IEC #:#,: This questionnaire covers ISO/IEC #:#, which ISO/IEC #:# has superseded. Filling it in today prepares against a withdrawn version — and above all against an Annex A that no longer exists in that form.
texte.Ce qui a été introduit dans les données: What was put into the training or tuning data steers the model's behaviour.
texte.Ce qui distingue la version # de la vers: What tells the # version from the # one: # controls in # themes instead of # in # chapters.
texte.Ce qui dépend du contexte de déploiement: What depends on the deployment context you cannot implement in the deployer's place: you SPECIFY it in the instructions for use, with its performance criteria, the competences required and the verification methods.
What is written, and what applies.
texte.Ce qui n'est PAS entièrement couvert, éc: What is NOT fully covered, in writing
texte.Ce qui ne se voit pas ligne à ligne se v: What does not show line by line shows on a map.
texte.Ce qui se réutilise d'un cadre à l'autre: What can be reused from one framework to another, and what cannot.
texte.Ce qui sépare les trois catégories, c'es: What separates the three categories is WHEN the human comes in: after the output, called by an alert, or already present. It is that « when » which decides whether the measure holds the deadline.
texte.Ce qui sépare une conception d'une mesur: What separates a design from a measure that works: acceptance criteria, tests, results.
texte.Ce taux mesure ce que l'industriel AJOUT: This rate measures what the industrial side ADDS to the #-# catalogue, and it is capped by what that catalogue already carries.
texte.Ce taux porte sur le cadre de gestion du: This rate covers the risk management framework and the contracts. It covers nothing else.
texte.Ce type d'entité figure à l'annexe I de: This kind of entity is listed in Annex I to the Directive. The absence of identification assumes the entity stays below the size thresholds of article #(#).
texte.Ce type d'entité ne figure ni à l'annexe: This kind of entity is listed in neither Annex I nor Annex II to the Directive. Identification as an essential or important entity therefore assumes a national designation under article #(#), points (b) to (e).
texte.Celle que la cyber revendique — et la se: The one cybersecurity claims — and the only one of the seven it covers.
texte.Cent pour cent ici ne veut pas dire arti: A hundred per cent here does not mean article # is met: it is the standard that announces its own limit.
texte.Certification au titre du règlement (UE): Certification under Regulation (EU) #/#, where a scheme is available and relevant.
texte.Certification par un organisme tiers acc: Certification by an accredited third-party body. Together with ISO/IEC #, one of the only two frameworks in this space that issues an enforceable certificate — the GDPR, NIS # and the CRA are law.
texte.Ces exigences sont-elles passées en revu: Are these requirements reviewed before the design is started?
texte.Ces points plafonnent le score : rien d': These points cap the score: nothing else will raise it while they hold.
texte.Cette date est fixée au plus tard un moi: That date is set no later than one month after the notification
texte.Cette exclusion ne se coche pas : elle s: This exclusion is not a tick-box: it is established text against text, risk by risk, against the essential requirements of Annex I. It calls for a legal analysis, not a declaration.
texte.Cette liste est celle de l'article # du: This list is the one in article # of Regulation (EU) #/#. It says what the contract must CONTAIN; it does not judge the drafting of the clauses, which is a matter for legal advice.
texte.Cette norme vise le FOURNISSEUR d'un sys: This standard addresses the PROVIDER of a high-risk AI system — the one who places it on the market or puts it into service under their own name. Outside that qualification, article # does not apply, and this module returns no rate.
texte.Cette revue relève du système de managem: This review comes under the quality management system (EN #:#): if you do not have one, it will have no trigger.
texte.Cette étiquette ne figure pas parmi les: This label is not among the twelve risks of §#. It is carried by the single action GV-#-# and kept as it stands, outside the list: rewriting it as one of the twelve would have invented a link the document does not make.
texte.Ceux qui subissent la décision ont-ils u: Whether those on the receiving end of the decision have a channel.
texte.Ceux qui tiennent le réseau de conduite: Those who run the control network
texte.Chacun des risques de la liste est trait: Each of the risks on the list is addressed, or set aside with its reason.
texte.Changements significatifs apportés aux a: Significant changes made to the subcontracting arrangements
texte.Chapitre IV (art. # à #) — notification: Chapter IV (art. # to #) — notification of conformity assessment bodies
texte.Chaque champ a une valeur « non renseign: Every field has a « not filled in » value: the green says that all those the block expects carry an answer.
texte.Chaque changement est-il passé en revue: Is every change reviewed before it is applied?
texte.Chaque point du cadre porte un état décl: Every point of the framework carries a declared and demonstrable state.
texte.Chaque risque se déclare traité, partiel: Each risk is declared addressed, partly addressed, or not.
texte.Chaque réviseur dispose-t-il des quatre: Does each reviewer have the four items without which the review is a formality: the captured sample, the proposed identification, the quality indicators, and the context — timestamps and alerts included?
texte.Chaque traitement, avec les six champs d: Every processing activity, with the six fields of article # the module tracks: purposes, legal basis, categories of data subjects and of data, retention period, security measures.
texte.Cinq exigences dans un seul paragraphe :: Five requirements in a single clause: this is the one where « we have a document management system » passes for an answer.
texte.Classification des actifs informationnel: Classification of information assets and ICT assets
texte.Classification des incidents liés aux TI: Classification of ICT-related incidents and cyber threats, and materiality thresholds.
texte.Cloisonner, filtrer, réduire l'expositio: Segmenting, filtering, reducing exposure — so that an intrusion stays where it came in.
texte.Cocher « autre solution technique » sans: Ticking « another technical solution » without those three pieces does not leave a requirement half met: it caps the rate, because §# requires them.
texte.Collecter, corréler et regarder les jour: Collecting, correlating and actually looking at the logs: seeing the attack while it is happening.
texte.Collectivement, les critères de l'incide: Collectively, the major-incident criteria of paragraph #
texte.Comparer AVEC et SANS les dispositifs d': Comparing WITH and WITHOUT the mitigations is what gives an interpretable result; a rate on its own says nothing.
texte.Composantes de la politique de continuit: Components of the ICT business continuity policy
texte.Composantes du plan de continuité des ac: Components of the ICT business continuity plan
texte.Conditions de participation aux programm: Conditions for taking part in digital operational resilience awareness and training programmes
texte.Conditions de sous-traitance des service: Conditions for subcontracting the ICT services that support critical or important functions
texte.Conditions relatives aux mesures et à la: Conditions relating to the measures and documentation implemented by the deployer
texte.Confirmer cette désignation auprès de l': Confirm that designation with the national authority before concluding that the carve-out applies.
texte.Confondre les risques DU système d'IA, q: Confusing the risks OF the AI system, which come under article #, with the risks bearing on the MANAGEMENT system, which are the ones in this chapter. The second then stays empty, and nobody notices.
texte.Connaître ses systèmes : inventaire, ver: Knowing your systems: inventory, versions, patches, end of support — what you cannot describe, you cannot defend.
texte.Contenu de la politique relative aux acc: Content of the policy on the contractual arrangements for ICT services supporting critical functions.
texte.Continuité des fonctions critiques ou im: Continuity of critical or important functions, through continuity plans and backup and restoration measures
texte.Contreparties centrales au sens de l'art: Central counterparties within the meaning of article #(#) of Regulation (EU) No #/#
texte.Conçoit ou fait concevoir le produit et: Designs the product, or has it designed, and places it on the market under their own name or trade mark.
texte.Coopération pleine du prestataire avec l: Full cooperation by the provider with the competent authorities and the resolution authorities
texte.Coter une catégorie suppose de savoir ce: Scoring a category assumes you know what it covers.
texte.Coûts et pertes supportés, ou susceptibl: Costs and losses incurred, or likely to be incurred, above # # EUR
texte.Creative Commons — se cite et s'adapte a: Creative Commons — may be quoted and adapted with attribution.
